item.title: Southern California ski resorts prepare for busy weekend after getting fresh snow from recent storms
item.description: Several feet of fresh snow from this week’s storms are expected to draw large crowds to local ski resorts and mountain communities this weekend. Resorts are reporting great conditions, while crews work to keep roads safe for drivers. The recent snowfall is also providing a boost to Southern California’s water supply through increased snowpack.Mountain High in Wrightwood is preparing for a busy weekend, with ski lifts ready and conditions described as ideal for visitors. item.title: Burbank water main break causes flooded streets
item.description: Cleanup efforts were underway in a Burbank neighborhood after a water main burst early Friday morning. Officials with Burbank Water and Power said crews responded to the water main break at 2:30 a.m. at the intersection of North Hollywood Way and north Whitnall Highway. While at the scene, FOX 11’s ground crew observed crews hard at working pumping out some of the water, also showing a muddy mess.The force of the water caused a white pickup truck parked on the street to lift. item.title: San Fernando Valley woman rescued after being held at knifepoint by husband: LAPD
item.description: A woman is thankful to be alive following a terrifying incident in the San Fernando Valley overnight. Around 2 a.m., the Los Angeles Police Department began receiving multiple 911 calls from a woman stating she was being held against her will at knifepoint by her husband. The incident happened at the couple’s home located near the intersection of Oro Vista Avenue and Wentworth Street in the Sunland area. item.description: A 29-year-old suspect has been charged with the murder of a renowned Caltech scientist. item.title: $180k worth of Pokémon cards stolen during smash-and-grab in Anaheim
item.description: Brazen thieves tunneled their way into a collectibles store in Anaheim, stealing approximately $180,000 worth of Pokémon cards. The entire incident was caught on surveillance video.
